parole.significato: Of a married or engaged person, to run away from home with a paramour.
parole.testo: From Anglo-Norman aloper (“to abduct, run away”), itself borrowed from Proto-West Germanic *andihlaupan (“to run away”). Equivalent to and- + lope as well as and- + leap (these being doublets). More at lope.

parole.significato: A container for arrows, crossbow bolts or darts, such as those fired from a bow, crossbow or blowgun.
